jei.pollutantpumpreforgedunofficial.pump: Stand a stack of Pump Pipes on top of this pump and power it with Forge Energy. Every few seconds it sucks one cloud of pollution from around the top pipe and pushes it into an adjacent Filter Frame (Pollution of the Realms), or releases it next to the pump when no filter has room.
jei.pollutantpumpreforgedunofficial.pipe: Right-click a pipe with another pipe to extend the tower upwards. Breaking a pipe removes every pipe above it. The top pipe decides where the pump sucks pollution from.
pollutantpumpreforgedunofficial.configur: Horizontal radius (X/Z) around the top pipe from which pollution is sucked.
Vertical range (Y) above and below the top pipe from which pollution is sucked.
Ticks between two suction attempts. 20 ticks = 1 second.
When an attempt finds nothing to suck, the wait before the next attempt doubles up to this many ticks, and resets after a success. Set equal to Work Interval to disable.
Energy consumed each time the pump successfully sucks one cloud of pollution.
Maximum energy the pump can store.
If enabled, the dropped pump item remembers its stored energy and restores it when placed again.
If enabled, pollution that no adjacent Filter Frame can hold is released into an empty block next to the pump.
